skipDependencyResolution.description: Sets spec.skipDependencyResolution on the Configuration. Only for a package whose dependencies are ALL listed explicitly in the same list (profiles/flux.yaml: harvester-vm). With it set, Crossplane installs none of that package's dependencies.

destination.description: Inert pass-through. Present so verify-catalog's probe values do not fail strict additionalProperties:false validation; the chart itself does not consume this field.
